QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Big Boar Attack!
QuestInfo.0: Loha at the clinic in the camp has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: Go see #eKanderune#n at #r#eBoulder Mountain Entrance#k#n, and see if he's learned anything about the giant boar.
QuestInfo.2: You met up with Kanderune at Boulder Mountain Entrance.

0.0: Thanks for your help earlier. I set aside that antidote in case anyone else decides to poison themselves on local cooking. I have a new task I need your help with, though.

yes.0: You know what happened to Duru, right? After being wounded by a boar, he's been helping out by managing our supplies.
yes.1: I honestly didn't believe him when he first told us about the giant boar, but since then, others claim to have seen it! #eKanderune#n at #b#e#m300010400##n#k has been investigating, and I'd like you to find out what he's learned. If such a thing really exists, we must do something about it!

no.0: Are you too busy right now? You don't look busy...

1.0: Hello, Kao. What brings you all the way here? Boulder Mountain is quite dangerous, you know.
